rawContent: Protests have erupted in the US state of Wisconsin after police shot a black man several times. The man, identified as Jacob Blake, is in a serious condition in hospital #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/38XnmTVseE

Jacob Blake’s father says there are now “eight holes” in his son’s body, and he’s paralyzed from the waist down after the police shooting in Kenosha. Doctors don’t yet know if the injury is permanent #JusticeForJacobBlake #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/7HYSZY9hvN

Newly released police video of a March incident that led to death of Daniel Prude, a Bosch man, in New York, shows officers covering his head with a "spit sock" and holding him on the ground in a prone position before he stopped breathing #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/Ay2PWCwPsd
